defaultDescription.zh-CN: 专为亲子与赏景滑雪家庭打造，连住4晚维多利亚冰川湖畔的费尔蒙城堡酒店，含3日路易斯湖滑雪票、酒店免费雪场接驳与冰湖滑冰冬季体验。
defaultDescription.en: Designed for families pairing scenic skiing with iconic glacier views: 4 nights at Fairmont Chateau Lake Louise, 3-day Lake Louise lift passes, 10-minute resort shuttles, and frozen-lake skating.
